name: Angus McLachlan
bio:
Angus's journey into motorsport began in the dusty workshops of rural Queensland, tinkering with farm machinery and dreaming of Formula One. After completing his engineering degree at the University of Melbourne, he cut his teeth in the Australian V8 Supercars series before making the leap to Europe. He spent several years with smaller teams, honing his skills and building a reputation for practical, no-nonsense problem-solving. His keen eye for detail and ability to extract maximum performance from limited resources caught the attention of Ferrari AF Corse, where he now leads a team of engineers dedicated to pushing the boundaries of GT racing.

Angus is known for his methodical approach and his emphasis on data-driven decision-making. He believes in empowering his team and fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels valued. He's not one for grand pronouncements or risky gambles; he prefers a steady, incremental approach that yields consistent results. His experience with diverse racing environments makes him uniquely qualified to optimize car setup for any track, and his mentorship of junior engineers is invaluable to the team.
